purpose: Teach: 手がかり/恐れる/惜しま/誇っ/心地よく/震える/諦める/寄席

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、宝探しの手がかり、絵本に書いてあった。
lines.en: Mom—there's a clue to the treasure hunt in the picture book.
lines.style: Quick, bright delivery. Urgent and eager. Little catch of breath between the two thoughts, like he can't quite wait. Lean forward slightly with the discovery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お化けを恐れるけど、大丈夫よ。
lines.en: Yes. You're scared of ghosts, but you'll be okay.
lines.style: Gentle reassurance. Steady breathing. Warm gaze downward at Sho. Not dismissing the fear—acknowledging it and moving past it together. Quiet certainty underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 走り回るの、惜しまずに、頑張った。
lines.en: I ran around as much as I could and really tried my best.
lines.style: Soft pride in the voice. Still a child's energy but contained, thoughtful. Slight rise on the effort part—he's reliving the moment. Pace steady, not breathless.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あなたを誇っているわ、本当に。
lines.style: Direct and unguarded. Warm gaze held steady. No performance—just honest feeling. Slight emphasis on 'truly' like she needs him to know she means it. Tender close.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お風呂のお湯、心地よく温かい。
lines.en: The bath water feels so warm and comfortable.
lines.style: Small, contented sigh underneath. Soft, drowsy observation. Like he's noticing the moment while living in it. Pace slows slightly. Trailing off gently at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 寒い夜、手が震える時、布団で温めようね。
lines.en: On cold nights when your hands are shaking, we'll warm them up together in the futon.
lines.style: Quiet, future-tense tenderness. Slow, deliberate pace. Reaches across the words gently—not rushed. Breath warm and close, almost a whisper. Promise underneath each word.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おもちゃ、まだ諦めるなって、お父さんが言った。
lines.en: Dad told me not to give up on my toy.
lines.style: Thoughtful, turning something over in his mind. Small voice, but steady. Like he's holding onto Dad's words. Slight pause before 'give up'—weighing it. Quiet conviction underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今度、寄席、お父さんと一緒に観に行きましょう。
lines.en: Next time we'll go see a yose comedy show together with Dad.
lines.style: Warm planning ahead. Brightness returning. Slight lift at the end—a small, genuine smile in the voice. Settled and content. Close on a note of looking forward together.
